title: Motor Thermal Shutdown
fullDescription:
Shark Navigator and Rocket vacuums shut off the motor when internal temperature exceeds safe limits. Usually caused by clogged filters or hose.

The vacuum must cool for 30-45 minutes before restart.

fixSteps.title: Wash filters
fixSteps.instruction: Rinse foam and felt filters; air-dry 24h.

fixSteps.title: Clear hose
fixSteps.instruction: Use broom handle to push through obstructions.

whenToCallPro: If motor never restarts after cooldown and cleaning.

title: Brush Roll Jammed
shortDescription: Brush bar cannot spin due to debris.
fullDescription: Shark floor-head indicator turns red when the brush roll has stalled — usually from hair, string, or carpet fibers wrapped around it.

fixSteps.title: Unplug vacuum
fixSteps.instruction: Always unplug before servicing brush roll.

fixSteps.title: Remove brush
fixSteps.instruction: Open brush door and lift out roll.

whenToCallPro: If belt or motor is damaged.
videoSearchQuery: Shark brush roll stuck red light

title: Hose or Wand Blocked
fullDescription: When suction drops dramatically, an obstruction is typically lodged in hose, wand, or floor nozzle.

fixSteps.title: Detach hose
fixSteps.instruction: Remove hose and check for blockages.

title: HEPA/Foam Filter Clogged
fullDescription: Clogged filters reduce suction and increase motor heat. Routine washing restores performance.

fixSteps.title: Remove filters
fixSteps.instruction: Pop dust cup lid, take out foam and felt.

fixSteps.title: Wash and dry
fixSteps.instruction: Rinse in water, air dry 24 hours.

fixSteps.title: Tap HEPA
fixSteps.instruction: Tap HEPA filter to dislodge dust; do not wash unless model supports it.

title: Battery Low (Cordless)
fullDescription: On Shark cordless Rockets a flashing red indicator shows battery below threshold; unit shuts off to protect cells.

fixSteps.title: Replace pack
fixSteps.instruction: If runtime under 5 min, replace battery pack.

title: Power Cord Damaged
shortDescription: Cord has visible cut or break.
fullDescription: Cuts or kinks in the power cord can cause intermittent operation and are a shock hazard.

fixSteps.title: Replace cord
fixSteps.instruction: Install OEM cord from service parts.

title: Power Switch Failure
shortDescription: On/off switch fails to engage motor.
fullDescription: Rocker switches on Shark uprights can fail mechanically over time.

title: Floorhead LED Out
fullDescription: LED headlamps can fail or a loose connector at the floorhead hinge can cause the light to go dark.

title: Drive Belt Broken
fullDescription: On models with belt-driven brush (older Navigator), a snapped belt leaves the brush stationary while motor runs.

fixSteps.title: Replace belt
fixSteps.instruction: Install fresh belt over motor shaft and brush roll.

title: Cordless Not Charging
shortDescription: Charger LED off or battery won't accept charge.
fullDescription: Charger base may have failed, contacts dirty, or battery pack at end of life. LED indicators on the handle show charger status.
